answer.summary: API Types Check failed because the committed src/utils/api-types.d.ts is stale. Regenerating from the API adds ImportLine and marking_definition_stix_id, which this PR's API change introduced but the types were not regenerated for. The diff is deterministic for this commit, so a re-run will fail the same way until the types are regenerated and committed.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
